Cargo

What is انبعاث البخار?

In this glossary, انبعاث البخار refers to: Release of vapours from cargo tanks or lines, controlled and monitored to prevent hazardous exposure, pollution, or breach of port regulations.

How is انبعاث البخار used in maritime?

Definition

Release of vapours from cargo tanks or lines, controlled and monitored to prevent hazardous exposure, pollution, or breach of port regulations.

Operational example

VTS to vessel: All vapour emission controls must be engaged during loading and unloading operations to comply with port safety standards.

Localized term

انبعاث البخار
